segments.visible_description: An official court record and a pink Burn Book entry are presented in the same confident handwriting.
segments.narration: AI writes in that same hand and with the same certainty, but it does not only write rumors.

segments.visible_description: A comic burst warns that unsupported information can look as finished as supported information.
segments.narration: It can combine a real source, old source and similar-but-not-this source.

segments.visible_description: An assumption card shows familiar patterns being inferred and stated as fact.
segments.narration: It adds an assumption because the pattern looked familiar.

segments.visible_description: A hallucination card defines plausible-sounding language filling a gap instead of admitting uncertainty.
segments.narration: The result arrives as one smooth paragraph in which every part appears to belong together.

segments.visible_description: The official record and Burn Book entry return with the explicit instruction to check before trusting the finish.
segments.narration: The official record and Burn Book entry have the same confidence and finish; you cannot tell which is which until you check.

editorial_decision: Replace the two long static cards with five narration-specific beats: shared confident voice, mixed-quality inputs, inferred assumption, smooth plausible answer, and the final court-record-versus-Burn-Book comparison. Existing approved Episode 03 art is used at its native meaning; generic camera movement is not counted as semantic progression.
